defaults.video_script: Mbappe cried after scoring three goals. France trailed two-nil after thirty-six minutes. Then Mbappe scored twice within two minutes. Two-two after ninety minutes. Extra time: Mbappe's third made it three-three. The first final hat-trick since nineteen sixty-six. Argentina still won four-two on penalties. He won the Golden Boot, eight goals. Mbappe was distraught as Argentina celebrated. President Macron came onto the pitch. He tried to comfort Mbappe. Greatest final performance ever, despite losing?
defaults.video_subject: Kylian Mbappe scored a hat-trick in the 18 December 2022 World Cup final at Lusail, a 3-3 draw that Argentina won 4-2 on penalties, the first final hat-trick since 1966, and President Macron came onto the pitch to console him.
